about: U2 WP10, gate U2-S1 C8 (a): the legacy `study_library/` (technology-data v0.14.0, the two seed tariffs, finance_defaults.yaml) frozen before WP10 deleted it. `ledgers` are `library.seed_ledger(BESS_AT_SITE, intake, load_library())` for the DE seed, the TOU seed and a user tariff on the golden site intake (rows 1-20, the WP0 ledger); `tariffs` the legacy library's seed tariffs; read by test_study_ledger_from_pack and the legacy-ledger tests in place of the deleted loader.

rows.help: Dimensionless, default 1.0 (the tariff as written). Scales each energy band's distance from the bands' time-weighted mean, so it widens (above 1) or narrows (below 1) the time-of-use spread without moving the average energy price; on a single-band tariff it changes nothing. Network charges, the demand charge and the export price are not scaled.
rows.label: Energy price level (multiplier on the tariff's energy bands around their time-weighted mean)
rows.technical_name: links_t.marginal_cost on grid_import: band = mean + value x (band - mean); network charges, demand charge and export credit unscaled

rows.help: Upper bound on the battery's MW and the PV's MW, as a multiple of the site's connection limit. A size at this bound is not an optimum: the verdict names it (size_at_upper_bound).
rows.label: Sizing limit for every extendable asset (multiple of the connection limit)
rows.source: Assumed (guided investment study plan v2, S4 / review v2 BC-2): two connection limits bound what import plus export can carry through the site connection
rows.technical_name: p_nom_max = connection_mw x value (battery StorageUnit, PV Generator)

honesty_help.tariff_demand_charge_monthly_peak_not_an: German network operators bill the capacity charge on the ANNUAL peak (Jahresleistungspreis); this seed bills each month's peak because MVP-1 models one monthly demand charge.
honesty_help.tariff_illustrative: Illustrative figures of a plausible order of magnitude, not a published tariff: replace them with the site's own bill.
Illustrative figures, not a published tariff.
honesty_help.tariff_isolates_energy_time_shift: No demand charge: the reference isolates energy time-shift value; the bands partition every hour of the week.
